opc. Start treatment with mycophenolate mofetil.

Standard medical consensus suggests that in the absence of clinical symptoms or abnormal investigations indicating active disease, the most advisable therapeutic attitude is surveillance expectant. This approach involves close monitoring for any signs of relapse or disease activity, as ANCA positivity can occur without active disease. Therefore, the focus should remain on clinical assessment and regular follow-up rather than initiating immunosuppressive therapy without evidence of active disease.
